author: ezpz-content
instruction_bn: গ্রাফ/চার্ট/টেবিলটি বর্ণনা করে লেখো। নিজে লেখার পর নমুনা ও checklist দেখো (Board: 15 marks)।

items.prompt: The graph shows the number of internet users in Bangladesh (in millions): 2018 - 80, 2019 - 95, 2020 - 110, 2021 - 125, 2022 - 130. Describe the graph.
items.model: The graph shows the number of internet users in Bangladesh from 2018 to 2022. The number of users is measured in millions. It is clear from the graph that the number of internet users increased steadily every year. In 2018 the number of users was eighty million. It rose to ninety-five million in 2019 and to one hundred and ten million in 2020. The number kept rising and reached one hundred and twenty-five million in 2021. Finally, in 2022 the number of users climbed to its highest point of one hundred and thirty million. To sum up, the graph makes it clear that the number of internet users in Bangladesh has been growing year after year. This shows the rapid spread of information technology and the growing use of the internet in the country.
rubric: শুরুতে graph কী দেখায় তা বলেছি
rose, reached, highest ইত্যাদি ব্যবহার করেছি

items.prompt: The table shows the number of male and female students in four classes: Class 6 (Boys 30, Girls 25), Class 7 (Boys 28, Girls 30), Class 8 (Boys 26, Girls 32). Describe the table.
items.model: The table shows the number of male and female students in three classes of a school. According to the table, in Class Six there are thirty boys and twenty-five girls. In Class Seven the number of boys is twenty-eight, while the number of girls is thirty. In Class Eight there are twenty-six boys and thirty-two girls. It is seen that the number of boys is higher only in Class Six, whereas the number of girls is higher in Class Seven and Class Eight. So the total number of students in the three classes is one hundred and seventy-one. To sum up, the table makes it clear that the number of girl students is gradually rising in the higher classes. This shows the growing awareness among the people about female education.
rubric: শুরুতে table কী দেখায় তা বলেছি

items.prompt: The graph shows the number of foreign tourists (in thousands) visiting a country: 2018 - 200, 2019 - 250, 2020 - 100, 2021 - 180, 2022 - 300. Describe the graph.
items.model: The graph shows the number of foreign tourists visiting a country from 2018 to 2022. The number of tourists is measured in thousands. It is clear from the graph that the number of tourists rose and fell during this period. In 2018 two hundred thousand tourists visited the country. The number rose to two hundred and fifty thousand in 2019. However, in 2020 it fell sharply to only one hundred thousand. After that, the number rose again to one hundred and eighty thousand in 2021 and reached the highest point of three hundred thousand in 2022. To sum up, though there was a sharp fall in 2020, the number of tourists rose again and became the highest in 2022. The fall in 2020 was probably caused by the pandemic, and the later rise shows the recovery of the tourism industry.
rubric: শুরুতে graph কী দেখায় তা বলেছি
rose, fell sharply, highest ইত্যাদি ব্যবহার করেছি

items.prompt: The pie chart shows the main crops grown in a country: Rice 55%, Wheat 15%, Jute 12%, Vegetables 10%, Others 8%. Describe the chart.
items.model: The pie chart shows the main crops grown in a country. Five kinds of crops are shown in the chart. According to the chart, rice is the main crop, which covers 55 percent of the total. Wheat comes next and covers 15 percent. Jute covers 12 percent, while vegetables cover 10 percent. The remaining 8 percent is covered by other crops. To sum up, the chart makes it clear that rice is by far the most important crop of the country, while other crops are grown in much smaller amounts. This shows that the country mainly depends on rice, which is the staple food of its people. It also shows that the farmers should grow more of other crops to keep a balance.
rubric: শুরুতে chart কী দেখায় তা বলেছি
main, next, remaining ইত্যাদি ব্যবহার করেছি

items.prompt: The graph shows the number of new schools built in a district: 2018 - 5, 2019 - 8, 2020 - 12, 2021 - 15, 2022 - 20. Describe the graph.
items.model: The graph shows the number of new schools built in a district from 2018 to 2022. It is clear from the graph that the number of new schools increased steadily every year. In 2018 five new schools were built in the district. The number rose to eight in 2019 and to twelve in 2020. It went up further to fifteen in 2021. Finally, in 2022 the number of new schools reached its highest point of twenty. Thus the number of new schools became four times larger in five years. To sum up, the graph makes it clear that more and more new schools were built in the district year after year. This shows the growing importance given to education and the effort to spread education among the people.
rubric: শুরুতে graph কী দেখায় তা বলেছি
rose, went up, highest ইত্যাদি ব্যবহার করেছি

items.prompt: The table shows the favourite fruits of the students of a class: Mango 22, Jackfruit 10, Banana 8, Litchi 6, Others 4. Describe the table.
items.model: The table shows the favourite fruits of the students of a class. Five kinds of fruits are mentioned in the table. It is seen from the table that mango is the most favourite fruit, as twenty-two students like it. Jackfruit comes next with ten students. Banana is liked by eight students, while litchi is the favourite of six students. Only four students like other fruits. So the total number of students in the class is fifty. To sum up, the table makes it clear that most of the students of the class like mango, which is called the king of fruits, while only a few like other fruits. This shows that mango is the most popular fruit among the students because of its sweet taste and delicious smell.

items.prompt: The graph shows the number of road accidents in a city: 2018 - 200, 2019 - 180, 2020 - 150, 2021 - 130, 2022 - 100. Describe the graph.
items.model: The graph shows the number of road accidents in a city from 2018 to 2022. It is clear from the graph that the number of road accidents fell steadily every year. In 2018 there were two hundred road accidents in the city. The number came down to one hundred and eighty in 2019 and to one hundred and fifty in 2020. It fell further to one hundred and thirty in 2021. Finally, in 2022 the number of accidents came down to its lowest point of one hundred. Thus the number of accidents was reduced by half in five years. To sum up, the graph makes it clear that the number of road accidents in the city has been falling year after year. This shows the good result of strict traffic rules and the growing awareness of the people about road safety.
rubric: শুরুতে graph কী দেখায় তা বলেছি
fell, came down, lowest ইত্যাদি ব্যবহার করেছি

items.prompt: The pie chart shows the ways students come to school: On foot 40%, By rickshaw 25%, By bus 20%, By bicycle 10%, Others 5%. Describe the chart.
items.model: The pie chart shows the different ways in which students come to school. Five ways are shown in the chart. According to the chart, most of the students come to school on foot, which is 40 percent. The next largest group, 25 percent, come by rickshaw. Twenty percent of the students come by bus, while 10 percent come by bicycle. The remaining 5 percent come in other ways. To sum up, the chart makes it clear that the largest number of students come to school on foot, while only a few use other means. This shows that most of the students live near the school and that walking, which is a good exercise, is the most common way of coming to school.
rubric: শুরুতে chart কী দেখায় তা বলেছি

items.prompt: The graph shows the amount of remittance (in billion dollars) sent by expatriates: 2018 - 15, 2019 - 18, 2020 - 20, 2021 - 22, 2022 - 24. Describe the graph.
items.model: The graph shows the amount of remittance sent by expatriates to their country from 2018 to 2022. The remittance is measured in billion dollars. It is clear from the graph that the amount of remittance increased steadily every year. In 2018 the expatriates sent fifteen billion dollars. The amount rose to eighteen billion dollars in 2019 and to twenty billion dollars in 2020. It went up further to twenty-two billion dollars in 2021. Finally, in 2022 the remittance reached its highest point of twenty-four billion dollars. To sum up, the graph makes it clear that the amount of remittance went on rising year after year. This shows the great contribution of the expatriates to the economy of the country and the growing number of people working abroad.

items.prompt: The table shows the number of computers in four schools: School A 20, School B 35, School C 15, School D 50. Describe the table.
items.model: The table shows the number of computers in four schools. The four schools are named A, B, C and D. It is seen from the table that School D has the largest number of computers, that is, fifty. School B has the second largest number with thirty-five computers. School A has twenty computers, while School C has the smallest number, only fifteen. So the four schools have a total of one hundred and twenty computers. To sum up, the table makes it clear that School D is the best equipped with computers, while School C has the fewest. This shows that the number of computers is not the same in all schools and that schools with fewer computers should be given more, so that all students can learn computer skills.

items.prompt: The graph shows the fish production of a country (in lakh tons): 2018 - 40, 2019 - 42, 2020 - 45, 2021 - 47, 2022 - 50. Describe the graph.
items.model: The graph shows the fish production of a country from 2018 to 2022. The production is measured in lakh tons. It is clear from the graph that the production of fish increased steadily every year. In 2018 the country produced forty lakh tons of fish. The production rose to forty-two lakh tons in 2019 and to forty-five lakh tons in 2020. It went up further to forty-seven lakh tons in 2021. Finally, in 2022 the production reached its highest point of fifty lakh tons. To sum up, the graph makes it clear that the production of fish went on rising year after year without any fall. This shows the success of modern fish farming and the hard work of the fishermen and fish farmers of the country.

items.prompt: The pie chart shows the causes of environmental pollution: Vehicles 35%, Factories 30%, Waste 20%, Deforestation 10%, Others 5%. Describe the chart.
items.model: The pie chart shows the main causes of environmental pollution. Five causes are shown in the chart. According to the chart, vehicles are the greatest cause of pollution, being responsible for 35 percent of it. Factories come next and cause 30 percent of the pollution. Waste is responsible for 20 percent, while deforestation causes 10 percent. The remaining 5 percent is caused by other reasons. To sum up, the chart makes it clear that vehicles and factories together cause most of the environmental pollution, while other causes are comparatively small. This shows that if we want to reduce pollution, we must first control the smoke of vehicles and factories and also plant more trees to keep the environment clean.
rubric: শুরুতে chart কী দেখায় তা বলেছি

items.prompt: The graph shows the number of trees survived out of trees planted in five years: 2019 - 80, 2020 - 90, 2021 - 70, 2022 - 110, 2023 - 130. Describe the graph.
items.model: The graph shows the number of planted trees that survived each year from 2019 to 2023. It is clear from the graph that the number of surviving trees generally increased over the years, with one fall. In 2019 eighty trees survived. The number rose to ninety in 2020. However, in 2021 it fell to seventy. After that, the number rose sharply to one hundred and ten in 2022 and reached the highest point of one hundred and thirty in 2023. To sum up, though there was a fall in 2021, the number of surviving trees increased steadily over the five years. This shows that the care taken of the young plants has improved and that more of the planted trees are now growing up successfully.

items.prompt: The table shows the number of books in four sections of a library: Story 300, Science 250, History 150, Reference 100. Describe the table.
items.model: The table shows the number of books in four sections of a library. The four sections are Story, Science, History and Reference. It is seen from the table that the Story section has the largest number of books, that is, three hundred. The Science section comes next with two hundred and fifty books. items.prompt: The graph shows the number of newspapers sold by a shop daily over a week: Monday 50, Wednesday 70, Friday 90, Sunday 60. Describe the graph.
